meaning:
κλίμα, -τος, τό
(κλίνω) [in LXX: Jdg.20:2 A (פִּנָּה)* ;]
1. an inclination, slope, esp. the slope from the equator to the pole (Arist).
2. a region (Polyb., al.): pl., Rom.15:23, 2Co.11:10, Gal.1:21.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
